verdict.rationale: Steel's Agent Traces docs describe turning a run into a timeline of agent activity so you can see what happened without scrubbing the whole recording. Runs can be exported as markdown, JSON, or a ZIP with screenshots, and the product overview explicitly lists session replays and agent observability, with dedicated Timeline, Traces API and Session Debugging pages. Together these cover replay-based debugging with timelines and screenshots. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of video replay playback (only implied by 'recording' and 'session replays'), explicit failure-diagnosis workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
